ranking_definition: Descending scenario trust within each parameter over all saved dates; ties: location, local date, parameter. Absolute movement and top ten compare with current saved trust. This is not the operational region-day cap.
limitations: Post-selection analysis of 175 retained, capped candidates; no refit, new events or ground truth.
Status rule fixed to incident presence in every scenario; no threshold or production policy change.
No low-severity alerts; low penalty effect not empirically evaluated.
Alternative penalties are illustrative choices, not expert-calibrated settings.
Detector coverage describes these candidates only; not ablation, sensitivity/recall or model accuracy.
